# `kernel/fs/ufs/ffs` — the Fast File System implementation

<!-- generated by tools/gen_folder_readmes.py -->

## English

This directory contains the Fast File System implementation.

`config.mk` records 7 source file(s) here: `ffs_alloc.c`, `ffs_balloc.c`, `ffs_inode.c`, `ffs_subr.c`, `ffs_tables.c`, `ffs_vfsops.c`, `ffs_vnops.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
